pairs.subject: quality-verdict-integrity
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/JudgeVerdictsView/verdictRollup.ts:50 Current-quality totals admit passes with missing or unknown provenance, allowing positive quality claims without confirmed content bindings.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/judge/calibration.ts:129 Confirmed labels are separated from provisional seeds, but the enforced agreement statistic is raw agreed/scored rather than the golden path's required chance-corrected agreement.

src/components/modules/evaluator/JudgeVerdictsView/verdictRollup.ts:70 The standing subset admits unknown and absent provenance without distinguishing verdict direction, so unverified passes increase passCount and average score; permission to retain condemnations does not authorize positive quality claims.

src/app/api/judge-verdicts/route.ts:83 The fleet submits no contentHash, so this fallback hashes a fresh database read after grading; an intervening rewrite can bind the verdict to content the judge never read.

src/lib/catalog/acceptance/judgeBridge.ts:102 A newest-present rubric newer than this build is classified unknown and remains eligible to condemn, whereas the standard requires a version not in force to be superseded and non-condemning.

src/lib/judge/siblingContext.ts:81 Nested projection, bounds, and separate context framing exist, but empty sibling projections are silently skipped without recording their emptiness with the verdict as required.

src/lib/status/craft.ts:185 Without comparable hashes, staleBecause returns null unless it detects a later timestamp, allowing an unprovable craft verdict to render gauged or at-ceiling instead of unknown.

pairs.registryProposal: Clarify that the shared counted-subset rule distinguishes applied condemnations from measured current quality: unknown may contribute to the former but must not contribute to the latter.
